CVE-2026-5430.evidence: Post reports CISA flagging the WSO2 JWT admin bypass as actively exploited; CISA added CVE-2026-5430 to the KEV catalog on 2026-09-24.

CVE-2026-71362.evidence: Same post flags the Magento/Adobe Commerce unauthenticated account takeover; CISA added CVE-2026-71362 to KEV on 2026-09-24.

decisions.reason: Corroborates the existing WSO2 CVE-2026-5430 story with the 2026-09-24 KEV additions covering both CVE-2026-5430 and CVE-2026-71362 (both CVEs already tracked by that story); belongs there, not a new story.

CVE-2026-5430.evidence: Event reports CISA added two exploited flaws to KEV on 2026-09-24, including WSO2 CVE-2026-5430 (CVSS 10.0, JWT algorithm mismatch auth bypass).

CVE-2026-71362.evidence: Same event reports the Adobe Commerce incorrect-authorization flaw CVE-2026-71362 (CVSS 9.1) as exploited and KEV-listed with August 2026 security release fixes.

decisions.reason: KEV update is a substantive status change for the WSO2 story; the Adobe Commerce CVE-2026-71362 half is already tracked in the same story's cves list.

decisions.story_title: Critical OS command injection flaws in Eufy Omni C20 and X10 Pro robot vacuums
decisions.reason: Real critical vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-93289, CVE-2026-93291, OS command injection) with patches available in widely deployed consumer IoT devices.

decisions.story_title: CISA advisory: malicious graphics file triggers client-side code execution in Siemens Desigo CC (CVE-2026-34223)
decisions.reason: CISA-issued advisory for a genuine ICS/BMS client code-execution flaw; distinct from the existing Siemens AV26-890 advisory story which covers different CVEs (2026-18963, 2026-50093).

CVE-2026-94127.evidence: Event reports the BIG-IP APM RCE is under active attack with a public PoC walkthrough; CVE-2026-94127 (CVSS 9.8) was KEV-listed 2026-09-22.

decisions.reason: PoC and active-attack reporting belong with the existing 35-event CVE-2026-94127 BIG-IP APM story.

decisions.story_title: Sudo CVE-2026-96512 lets local users bypass time-based restrictions
decisions.reason: New high-severity flaw in core Linux privilege management with mitigation guidance; relevant to any hardened multi-user host.

CVE-2026-80521.evidence: Event reports a public exploit for the AF_UNIX garbage-collector use-after-free that breaks container isolation to host root on Ubuntu 22.04 kernels.

decisions.reason: Ubuntu-specific follow-up on the public exploit belongs in the existing CVE-2026-80521 container-escape story.
404media reporting that the FBI hack exposed the bureau's own hacking unit personnel data is core reporting for the existing ShinyHunters-FBI story (21 events).

decisions.story_title: containerd CVE-2026-53493: crafted image exhausts node CPU and memory during pull
decisions.reason: Patched vulnerability in core container infrastructure; a crafted image can pin node resources during pull before any container runs. Relevant to any Kubernetes fleet.
